description: This file defines the DefaultContentLocalizationManager class, which implements content localization management functions such as retrieving localized content items, localizing content, and deduplicating content items within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: DefaultContentLocalizationManager
classes.description: Implements content localization management, including retrieving, creating, and deduplicating localized content items within OrchardCore.

methods.name: GetContentItemAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a content item for a specific localization set and culture.

methods.name: GetItemsForSetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all content items for a given localization set.

methods.name: GetItemsForSetsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves content items for multiple localization sets and a specific culture.

methods.name: LocalizeAsync
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a localized version of a content item for a target culture.

methods.name: DeduplicateContentItemsAsync
methods.description: Deduplicates a list of content items based on localization sets and current culture.

methods.name: GetFirstItemIdForSetsAsync
methods.description: Gets the first content item ID for each localization set, respecting culture priorities.

methods.name: GetSingleContentItemIdPerSet
methods.description: Selects a single content item index per localization set based on culture priority rules.
